entities.summary: Heinz Reinhard Becker was a Major League Baseball first baseman for the Chicago Cubs and Cleveland Indians from 1943–1947. A switch hitter, Becker was a member of the Cubs during their National League pennant win in 1945 but made his prominence with the Milwaukee Brewers of the American Association during the 1940s.
